pages.title: GPU backend
pages.description: The GPU backend uses the CUDA driver API through bun:ffi and kernels written as PTX, generated by packages/gpu/src/cuda/ptx.ts and compiled by the driver when a device is created. nvcuda.dll ships with the NVIDIA display driver, so no toolkit and no native build step are needed, and the project stays free of dependencies. cuBLAS belongs to the CUDA Toolkit and is not used. WebGPU is not used because Bun has no built-in implementation.
